create_observer_class: create a custom Observer subclass that tracks specific keys and handles update callbacks
create_aggregator_class: create a custom Aggregator subclass that collects and aggregates values for a specific key
use_observable_decorator: use the observable decorator to mark a class as producing observable values with typed keys
add_observer_to_observable: add an Observer instance to an observable class to receive notifications on value changes
notify_observers_with_values: call notify_observers on an observable class to broadcast key-value updates to registered observers
